verdict.rationale: Kling has an in-product Agent with Skills, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The only MCP evidence ('MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling') describes external agents driving Kling, which is the server role. Nothing documents Kling's Agent connecting to or consuming user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
